decision: Deploy flowable/flowable-rest:7.1.0 (Apache 2.0, pinned) as an additive 'flowable' service in docker-compose.yml, connected to the existing shared Postgres instance via JDBC with ACT_* tables isolated in a dedicated 'flowable' schema (init-script config/postgres/002-flowable-schema.sql, mirroring the Keycloak pattern). BPMN deployment uses the REST API exclusively (POST /flowable-rest/service/repository/deployments multipart — spike-proven). A committed smoke BPMN (config/flowable/processes/choros-smoke.bpmn20.xml, key chorosSmoke, external-task topic smoke-topic) is the CI fitness target. Host port 8082 (FLOWABLE_PORT env). No src/ files touched; FF-G3 (T-0028) stays dormant.

rejected_alternatives.why_not: Implicit deploy at startup leaves the REST path untested by default, which is the path T-0064 will use. REST deploy is already spike-proven and must be CI-exercised explicitly.

rejected_alternatives.option: Rely on ACT_ name-prefix uniqueness in public schema instead of dedicated schema
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Naming convention is not a hard boundary; future migration naming mistakes would silently collide. The dedicated schema pattern (same as Keycloak's keycloak schema) provides a verifiable hard boundary.
Hard red-line from stack ADR §1 (NF-3): one Postgres instance per contour. Rejected immediately.
Stack ADR and founder ratification (2026-06-10) chose Flowable 7 primary based on dedicated deadletter-move REST semantic (action=move). Operaton remains documented de-risked fallback.

fields.name: healthcheck
fields.type: wget GET /flowable-rest/service/management/engine with basic-auth, interval 5s, retries 24, start_period 30s

fields.name: tables
fields.type: ACT_* (Liquibase-managed by Flowable engine on first start)

contracts: Deploy BPMN: POST /flowable-rest/service/repository/deployments multipart/form-data field=deployment → HTTP 201 JSON {id: string}
Smoke process key: chorosSmoke (consumed by T-0064 as first REST-client integration target)
External-task topic: smoke-topic (consumed by T-0067 as first external-task mapping target)

fitness_functions.rule: After docker compose up flowable, GET /flowable-rest/service/management/engine with admin basic-auth returns HTTP 200 within 120s
POST /flowable-rest/service/repository/deployments with choros-smoke.bpmn20.xml returns HTTP 201 with a deployment ID in the JSON body
After deploy, POST .../runtime/process-instances {processDefinitionKey:chorosSmoke} returns HTTP 201; GET .../runtime/process-instances?processDefinitionKey=chorosSmoke returns total >= 1
docker-compose.yml flowable service uses exactly image flowable/flowable-rest:7.1.0 (no :latest); no *LICENSE*, *ENTERPRISE*, or *ACTIVATION* env var is set
docker-compose.yml contains exactly one postgres image line; flowable SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL contains 'postgres:5432' (shared instance)
All host-side port values in docker-compose.yml are unique; FLOWABLE_PORT default 8082 does not appear in non-flowable service port mappings
SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD and FLOWABLE_REST_APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD in compose use ${VAR:-dev_default} form; only choros_dev_pw and choros_flowable_dev_pw appear as password literals
flowable service block in docker-compose.yml declares depends_on.postgres.condition: service_healthy
Compose flowable environment contains FLOWABLE_ENABLE_HISTORY_CLEANING: true and FLOWABLE_HISTORY_CLEANING_CYCLE with a non-empty value
config/flowable/processes/choros-smoke.bpmn20.xml contains a serviceTask with flowable:type="external" and a non-empty flowable:topic attribute
The postgres and keycloak service blocks in docker-compose.yml are byte-identical to the T-0054 baseline (git show 2f749a9:docker-compose.yml)
fitness_functions.ci_check: bash ci/checks/flowable/static-checks.sh (FF-FL-11 section: diff against baseline)

fitness_functions.rule: After compose up, Postgres flowable schema contains ACT_* tables; public schema contains choros_* tables; intersection of table names is empty
fitness_functions.ci_check: bash ci/checks/flowable/smoke.sh or dedicated schema-isolation.sh via docker compose exec postgres psql

fitness_functions.rule: src/bridge/ and src/core/flowable*.ts do not exist (T-0028 bridge-contract probe exits 0; T-0058 must not create these paths)

traceability.covered_by: FF-FL-4 (static-checks.sh image pin + no enterprise key)
FF-FL-5 (static-checks.sh single postgres + SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL points to postgres service)
FF-FL-12 (schema-isolation: ACT_* in flowable schema, choros_* in public, zero intersection); 002-flowable-schema.sql init-script
FF-FL-7 (static-checks.sh password form check); updated no-committed-secret.sh
FF-FL-10 (static-checks.sh grep flowable:type=external + flowable:topic in smoke BPMN)
FF-G3 (flowable-bridge-contract.sh exits 0; no src/bridge/ or src/core/flowable*.ts in T-0058 scope)
New CI job 'flowable' in .github/workflows/ci.yml (§6); fitness:flowable target in package.json
FF-FL-11 (static-checks.sh diff postgres+keycloak blocks against 2f749a9 baseline)

runtime_target: контейнер (docker-compose) — локально и CI; продовый деплой = E0.7 (founder-gated, GT-4)
